name: Existing project audit and model diagnosis

discrepancies.observation_in_photo: The reference photograph prominently displays vibrant sky-blue / azure tinted glass bands along every curved balcony facade.
discrepancies.current_model_state: Current material 'Mat_Facade_Tinted_Glass' has a darker navy-bronze tint (0.10, 0.18, 0.26), which looks darker and less vibrant than the approved photograph.
discrepancies.repair_action: Tune balcony glass shader to match the approved vibrant sky-blue/cyan hue with crisp transmission and specular reflection: RGB ~(0.12, 0.58, 0.88), roughness 0.04, transmission 0.85.

discrepancies.observation_in_photo: Crisp, brilliant clean white slab edges emphasize the curved cantilever rhythm across all 22 structural levels.
discrepancies.current_model_state: Slab edge material 'Mat_Slab_Fascia' is slightly muted cream (0.94, 0.92, 0.88).
discrepancies.repair_action: Increase brightness and crispness of 'Mat_Slab_Fascia' to architectural brilliant white (0.98, 0.98, 0.98) with subtle bevel highlights.

discrepancies.observation_in_photo: Warm beige/terracotta vertical fluted piers rise vertically across the central bays.
discrepancies.current_model_state: Vertical fins exist but their tone is slightly dark timber (0.58, 0.36, 0.24).
discrepancies.repair_action: Calibrate 'Mat_Fluted_Timber_Accent' to warm architectural sandstone/terracotta tone (0.72, 0.48, 0.32) matching the sunlit photograph.

discrepancies.observation_in_photo: Spacious clear glazed double-height lobby with clean drop-off turnaround and lush flanking perimeter trees.
discrepancies.current_model_state: Podium is modeled at 4.5m double height with canopy columns; tree placements are good.
discrepancies.repair_action: Maintain 4.5m double height and add refined paved entrance driveway textures and warm interior lobby lighting.

discrepancies.observation_in_photo: Camera is stationed at the South-East corner driveway looking up at ~15° pitch, capturing the full soaring elevation from podium to pergola.
discrepancies.current_model_state: Milestone 1 camera is close but can be matched within fraction-of-a-degree precision to produce an exact side-by-side overlay.
discrepancies.repair_action: Create dedicated camera 'Hero_Photo_Match_Cam' calibrated directly to the focal length (28mm equivalent) and exact viewpoint of the reference photograph.
